scenarios.title: Reinforce discards the card from hand and puts counters on the target creature
decisions: A activates reinforce 1 of Mosquito Guard from hand, tapping two Plains for {1}{W}, discarding Mosquito Guard as a cost, targeting Grizzly Bears.
Both players pass; the ability resolves.

variants.label: target_legal
variants.expected: Mosquito Guard is in A's graveyard and Grizzly Bears has one +1/+1 counter (3/3).

variants.label: target_killed_in_response
variants.delta: In response, B casts Shock targeting Grizzly Bears, tapping Mountain.
variants.expected: Shock resolves first and Grizzly Bears dies. The reinforce ability fizzles. Mosquito Guard is still in A's graveyard because it was discarded as a cost.

operation.unclassifiable: choice: B responds by casting Shock on Grizzly Bears

detector.outcome: A reinforce ability resolves and puts +1/+1 counters on its target creature.
detector.near_miss: A reinforce ability resolves and puts no counters.

scenarios.title: Reinforce can be activated only while the card is in its owner's hand
decisions: Evaluate whether A may activate reinforce 1 of Mosquito Guard with two untapped Plains and Grizzly Bears as a target.

variants.label: in_hand
variants.expected: The activation is legal (can_play true) and Grizzly Bears is a legal target.

variants.label: on_battlefield
variants.delta: Mosquito Guard is on A's battlefield instead of in hand.
variants.expected: The activation is not legal (can_play false), because reinforce works only from hand.

operation.unclassifiable: more than one fact: Mosquito Guard is added to the battlefield and leaves the hand

variants.label: in_graveyard
variants.delta: Mosquito Guard is in A's graveyard instead of in hand.
variants.expected: The activation is not legal (can_play false).

detector.outcome: An ability that functions only from one zone (the hand) passes the zone check because its card is in that zone.
detector.near_miss: The candidate fails the zone check because its card is in another zone.

scenarios.title: A reinforce card has an activated ability in every zone
decisions: A activates Tazri's mill ability, paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} with the five lands and tapping Tazri.
Both players pass; the ability resolves: A mills five cards, then puts every creature card with a non-mana activated ability among them into hand.

variants.label: reinforce_card
variants.expected: The five milled cards are Mosquito Guard and four Grizzly Bears. Mosquito Guard returns to A's hand because its reinforce ability exists in the graveyard. The four Grizzly Bears stay in A's graveyard.

variants.label: vanilla_card
variants.delta: The top card of the library is Goblin Piker instead of Mosquito Guard.
variants.expected: Goblin Piker has no activated ability, so all five milled creature cards stay in A's graveyard and A's hand is empty.

scenarios.forge_notes: Relies on Forge's hasNonManaActivatedAbility property counting the reinforce keyword's hand-only ability for a card in the graveyard.
